lessons_used: Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%).
Adding desktop ready background notification prompts was helpful (+5.1%).
Copy updates and quick hints (spawning instructions, account recovery warnings, overlay hints) showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen updates (progress indicators and tip carousels) showed no clear effect.
Layout tweaks and narrative redesigns showed no clear effect and can trigger guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% vs +5.1%).

lessons_next: Moving sign-in after adoption selection was helpful (+5.5%), but reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Desktop ready background notification prompts were helpful (+5.1%), but sound cue notifications showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, overlay hints, and headline changes showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen progress indicators and tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Layout tweaks and visual redesigns showed no clear effect and risk severe negative drops or guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the background notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% predicted vs +5.1% measured).
